name: smallstack-skills
description: AI skill index for Django SmallStack. Read the relevant skill before modifying the corresponding part of the codebase.
source: docs/skills/README.md (+ local.md for this project's own skills)

skills.name: From Zero To Running
skills.description: **New project? Start here** — clone → local setup → first app → production, each phase with its verification command
skills.use_when: Starting a brand-new SmallStack project, from clone to production.

skills.name: CLI Tools
skills.description: **Start here for "is there a tool for X?"** — task → tool / failure → tool / tool → docs lookup tables
skills.use_when: Before running ANY operational task — diagnose, verify, mint a token, back up, screenshot, deploy. Check here before writing a bash one-liner.

skills.name: Modern Dark Theme
skills.description: **Read before building any page** — canonical patterns, anti-patterns, variable list for the v0.9.x modern-dark theme
skills.use_when: Before building any new page, card, table, modal, or badge — the canonical patterns that render correctly on every palette.

skills.name: Accessibility
skills.description: **Read before building any page/form/modal** — a11y primitives (`.sr-only`, `.skip-link`, `:focus-visible`, `trapFocus`), the rules, and the pre-"done" checklist (WCAG 2.1 AA)
skills.use_when: Before shipping any page, form, table, modal, or interactive control — the a11y primitives and the pre-done checklist.

skills.name: Modify Palettes
skills.description: **Change accent colors** — add a brand palette or tune one. The 4 wiring points (yaml/CSS/model+migration/`VALID_PALETTES`), color-science gotchas, verification
skills.use_when: Before adding or tuning a color palette — the four wiring points and the color-science gotchas.

skills.name: Add Gold Theme
skills.description: Worked example of adding one palette (Gold) end to end — read `modify-palettes.md` first; this is the concrete walk-through, not the canonical guide

skills.name: Search
skills.description: Add keyword search + MCP tool to a CRUDView (`enable_search = True`) — FTS5/PG-FTS backend dispatch, RAG via Claude Desktop
skills.use_when: Before adding enable_search = True or building any search-shaped feature.

skills.name: Datasets
skills.description: **Build a dashboard/report/chart UI** — the `@dataset` primitive: a named queryset surfaced as typed rows/columns (`schema()` → dimension/measure + filter widgets), `rows()`/`series()`, opt-in REST + MCP. Read before building anything that inspects a dataset to render pickers/charts
skills.use_when: Before exposing a filtered queryset as typed rows/columns for a dashboard, report, or chart UI.

skills.name: Django Apps & CRUDView
skills.description: Creating apps, CRUDView management pages, title bar pattern
skills.use_when: Creating a new app, adding a model, building management pages, or wiring up CRUDView.

skills.name: CRUD Views
skills.description: **The CRUDView reference** — the declarative class behind list/create/detail/update/delete: actions, config attributes, display protocol, related tabs, `get_list_queryset`
skills.use_when: Before configuring or extending a CRUDView — the reference for its attributes, actions, and display protocol.

skills.name: Explorer
skills.description: Model Explorer — the zero-code CRUD browser generated from existing `ModelAdmin` registrations; `explorer_displays`, dashboard widgets

skills.name: Filtering Export
skills.description: Declarative search, filtering, and CSV/JSON export on a CRUDView + its REST layer

skills.name: Building A User Facing Site
skills.description: **Read for any non-staff user-facing surface** — LoginRequiredMixin + tenancy scoping + SearchAccess for end-user dashboards, "my X" lists, public catalogues
skills.use_when: Before building any non-staff surface — end-user dashboards, 'my X' lists, public catalogues.

skills.name: Template System
skills.description: Template inheritance, blocks, includes, common patterns
skills.use_when: Creating or modifying HTML templates, understanding block inheritance, or adding includes.

skills.name: Navigation
skills.description: The nav registry that drives both sidebar and topbar — zones, ordering, INSTALLED_APPS-driven entries

skills.name: Admin Page Styling
skills.description: **Definitive UI reference**: buttons, cards, tables, stat cards, action cards, tabs, filter toggles, forms, modals, starter template
skills.use_when: When you need the exhaustive component reference while building an admin page.

skills.name: Components
skills.description: Quick-reference component catalog — the short form of `admin-page-styling.md`

skills.name: Theming System Reference
skills.description: CSS variables, palettes, dark mode
skills.use_when: Understanding the theming architecture, adding a new palette, or debugging theme/palette issues.

skills.name: Adding a Custom Theme
skills.description: **Bring your own look** — mount Bootstrap / Tailwind / a bespoke base template *alongside* SmallStack's theme (for teams with an existing design system). Not for changing colors — that's `modify-palettes.md`
skills.use_when: The user wants to use their own CSS framework for public pages while keeping SmallStack's theme for admin tools.

skills.name: Theme Integration Scenarios
skills.description: Three theme integration scenarios: public-only, user login, or build on SmallStack
skills.use_when: The user is deciding how to integrate their theme, or an AI needs to understand which approach to take.

skills.name: Authentication
skills.description: Custom user model, auth views, protecting views
skills.use_when: Working with auth views, protecting pages, configuring signup, or extending the User model.

skills.name: User Management
skills.description: The staff-only User Manager — search, profiles, activity stats, timezone dashboard, email/password-reset configuration

skills.name: Testing
skills.description: **Read before writing tests** — pytest/locmem stack, patterns for email + multi-step auth flows + CRUDView + guardrails, regression guards, and the `form.is_valid()`/`DeleteView` gotchas
skills.use_when: Writing or changing tests — especially for auth, email, CRUDView, or User Manager work.

skills.name: Manage API Tokens
skills.description: Pick the right token surface (/smallstack/tokens/, CLI, OAuth) by question; permissions matrix; reveal-once flow
skills.use_when: Before answering any API-token question — which surface to use, what permissions apply.

skills.name: htmx Patterns
skills.description: htmx setup, CSRF, partials, dual-response views, OOB messages
skills.use_when: Adding htmx interactions, building partials, or implementing inline updates.

skills.name: Help & Documentation System
skills.description: Help system, sections, bundled SmallStack docs
skills.use_when: Adding or editing help pages, creating new doc sections, or configuring the help system.

skills.name: Runbook & Dynamic Documents
skills.description: **Read before writing to runbook docs any way but the UI** — versioned markdown documents via web, `service`, MCP, REST, CLI; FTS search, locking, retention, ownership, anti-patterns
skills.use_when: Creating or writing runbook documents any way other than the web UI, or wiring runbook search/MCP/export.

skills.name: Runbook CLI
skills.description: The `manage.py runbook` / `rb` unix-style CLI for runbook pages — verbs, stdin piping, JSON, provenance, locking
skills.use_when: Browsing or editing runbook pages from the shell.

skills.name: sc — framework CLI
skills.description: The `manage.py sc` / `sc` framework CLI — generic CRUD over any CRUDView (`ls/get/describe/new/set/rm`) + ops verbs (`doctor/backup/token/status/index/commands`); same validation + audit as REST/MCP
skills.use_when: Inspecting, querying, or mutating any CRUDView model from the shell, discovering the model/command surface, or health-checking the framework — instead of ad-hoc manage.py shell snippets.

skills.name: Settings & Configuration
skills.description: Split settings, environment variables, feature flags
skills.use_when: Changing settings, adding environment variables, or understanding the split settings architecture.

skills.name: Timezone Handling
skills.description: Timezone middleware, per-user timezone, localtime_tooltip tag
skills.use_when: Working with dates/times, adding timezone-aware displays, or understanding the timezone middleware.

skills.name: Background Tasks
skills.description: Django Tasks framework with django-tasks-db backend
skills.use_when: Adding background jobs, making a task retry on failure, diagnosing a task stuck RUNNING, configuring the worker deployment (inline vs separate), or understanding the task queue.

skills.name: Scheduler
skills.description: **Recurring jobs** — the `@scheduled` decorator, the scheduler UI, cron/interval/once cadences, the tick, overlap/catch-up policies
skills.use_when: Before scheduling recurring work with @scheduled or the scheduler UI.

skills.name: Approvals
skills.description: **Human-in-the-loop approval gate** — `@approval_kind` + `request_approval()`, the decision console, eligibility rules (assignees/self-approval/staff), the callback + signal + webhook + poll reaction paths, expiry sweep
skills.use_when: Before gating an action on a human decision — an approval step or an AI-agent HITL gate.

skills.name: Notifications
skills.description: **In-app notifications** — the never-raising `notify()` service, the topbar bell + unread badge, the inbox, per-user REST, daily prune
skills.use_when: Before surfacing an in-app 'you should see this' message to a signed-in user.

skills.name: Webhooks
skills.description: **Webhooks** — a foundational integration surface: outbound event delivery (`enable_webhooks = True`) + inbound receivers (`@webhook_handler`), plus **four extension seams** (`@webhook_transform`/`@webhook_auth`/`@webhook_verifier`/`@webhook_challenge`) that make Zapier/n8n/Stripe/Slack/Event Grid plug-ins, first-class **SmallStack↔SmallStack** pairing (`sc webhook pair`, loop-safe), stable `event_id` dedupe, `Retry-After` + bulk dead-letter replay
skills.use_when: Before ANY integration work — outbound delivery, inbound receivers, provider plug-ins, or pairing two SmallStacks.

skills.name: RSS
skills.description: **RSS/Atom feeds** — symmetric publish + consume surface. Publish a model with `enable_rss = True` (or a curated `Feed`); the enclosure/podcast seam is `rss_item_extra`. Consume external feeds into a model with `register_feed_source` + the collector (`@scheduled` + `manage.py collect_feeds`). Status-page feed is the reference
skills.use_when: Before publishing a model as a feed or consuming an external feed into a model.

skills.name: Activity Tracking
skills.description: HTTP request logging middleware and configuration
skills.use_when: Configuring request logging, excluding paths, or working with the activity dashboard.

skills.name: Logging & Audit Trail
skills.description: Logging configuration, audit trail, and **reading logs from a deployment you can't shell into** — JSON output with `request_id` correlation, DB-backed capture, the `/smallstack/logs/` staff viewer, time-boxed capture windows
skills.use_when: Configuring logging, adding audit trails, debugging log output, correlating an X-Request-ID to log lines, or reading logs from a deployment you cannot shell into.

skills.name: Screenshot Workflow
skills.description: Visual verification with shot-scraper and screenshot_auth
skills.use_when: Taking screenshots to verify UI changes, especially in both light and dark modes.

skills.name: Docker Deployment
skills.description: Docker Compose setup, services, volumes
skills.use_when: Setting up Docker, modifying the Dockerfile, or configuring container services.

skills.name: Kamal Deployment
skills.description: Kamal deployment configuration, VPS setup, SSL, commands
skills.use_when: Deploying to production, configuring Kamal, or troubleshooting deployment issues.

skills.name: Development Workflow
skills.description: Branching, testing, coverage, documentation, commit style
skills.use_when: Understanding development conventions, running tests, or preparing commits.

skills.name: Release Process
skills.description: Versioning, release checklist, GitHub releases — the ritual for cutting a SmallStack release from *this* repo. A fork that cuts its own releases should keep its own release doc and read `integration-workflow.md` instead
skills.use_when: Preparing a release, bumping the version, or creating a GitHub release.

skills.name: Upstream Integration
skills.description: Pulling upstream SmallStack into a fork and redeploying — remote setup, the conflict-resolution table, post-merge verification
skills.use_when: Merging upstream SmallStack updates into a project built on it.

skills.name: Adopting Smallstack
skills.description: Adopting SmallStack into an *existing* Django project — overlay into the current repo vs fresh clone + app migration

skills.name: Downstream Release Migration
skills.description: Migrating a fork onto a new release — additive vs breaking changes, the false-test-result + removed-symbol traps, this release's actions

skills.name: Merge v0.12.0
skills.description: **Merging the v0.12.0 release** into an older base — the `django-tables2` removal (BREAKING) plus the status-monitoring subsystem's integration points (surface toggles, route gating, the `views` autodiscover that moved to the core, INSTALLED_APPS, migrations)
skills.use_when: Bringing a downstream project up to v0.12.0 — reconciling the status-monitoring subsystem and surface toggles against a customized settings/urls/apps layout.

skills.name: API Discovery
skills.description: API discovery endpoints: schema introspection, OpenAPI spec, OPTIONS metadata
skills.use_when: Before integrating a client against the API surface — schema, spec, and OPTIONS metadata.

skills.name: REST API
skills.description: **The REST API reference** — token auth, CRUD endpoints, FK expansion, date filtering, aggregation, serialization
skills.use_when: Building or consuming REST API endpoints, managing tokens, or configuring API authentication and access levels.

skills.name: Frontend Integration
skills.description: SmallStack as a headless backend for React/Vue/Next/Svelte — token architecture, CORS, the full user lifecycle
skills.use_when: Setting up SmallStack as a backend API for a frontend framework, or understanding the system token + login token architecture.

skills.name: Custom API Endpoints
skills.description: Building non-CRUD API endpoints with the `@api_view` decorator
skills.use_when: Before adding a REST endpoint that isn't CRUD over a model.

skills.name: API Doctor
skills.description: Debug API setup + threat signals via `/smallstack/api/` (Health + Activity) and `python manage.py api_doctor`
skills.use_when: Before debugging an API setup, an empty Swagger, or a weird-traffic report.

skills.name: Dashboard Cards
skills.description: **The stat-card standard**: the `{% stat_card %}` tag, the global drill-down modal, and the `render_stat_list` helper for the metric tiles atop dashboard pages
skills.use_when: Before adding metric tiles or drill-down modals to the top of a dashboard page.

skills.name: Dashboard Widgets
skills.description: Dashboard widget protocol: `DashboardWidget` class, Explorer vs standalone registration, data layer, REST API
skills.use_when: Before adding a widget to the central /smallstack/ dashboard.

skills.name: Status Monitors
skills.description: **The status/uptime monitoring standard**: register a `Service` + `Monitor` (cheap `check()`), the 3-tier taxonomy (Site / Site Monitors / External), the branded public `/status/` page (90-day timelines + maintenance calendar), per-monitor public flag + independent SLA/maintenance, the no-code Add-monitor wizard, and pluggable `Visualization` panels
skills.use_when: Before monitoring a subsystem's uptime/health, exposing a health check on the status page, or adding a status visualization.

skills.name: Card & Calendar Displays
skills.description: Card grid displays: `CardDisplay` (key-value), `AvatarCardDisplay`, authoring new card variants
skills.use_when: Building list displays that render as card grids, configuring CardDisplay/AvatarCardDisplay for a model, or authoring a new card variant or list display family.

skills.name: Calendar Displays
skills.description: Month-grid calendar display: `CalendarDisplay` config, ranged vs single-date events, month navigation
skills.use_when: Adding a month-grid calendar view to a model, configuring CalendarDisplay for date-ranged events, or authoring a new date-based list display (week, gantt, timeline).

skills.name: Update Docs And Skills
skills.description: File group map for updating docs/skills after code changes
skills.use_when: After changing code, to find every doc and skill file that references the area you touched.

skills.name: MCP: Enable MCP For A Model
skills.description: Opt a CRUDView into MCP via `enable_mcp = True`

skills.name: MCP: End User Tools
skills.description: **Read for non-staff MCP** — `LoginRequiredMixin` + `get_list_queryset` tenancy + `search_access`/`search_visibility` so Alice's token sees only Alice's data

skills.name: MCP: Write A Custom Tool
skills.description: Add cross-cutting tools with the `@tool` decorator + `current_context()`

skills.name: MCP: Add A Write Tool
skills.description: Expose create/update/delete via factory vs custom write tools

skills.name: MCP: Connect Claude Desktop
skills.description: Connect Claude Desktop / Claude.ai Connectors UI to the server

skills.name: MCP: Debug MCP Failure
skills.description: Decision tree for diagnosing connector failures
skills.use_when: Before debugging an MCP connector failure or a 'Claude can't see my tools' report.

skills.name: MCP: Add MCP To This Project
skills.description: Bootstrap MCP in a fresh / non-MCP-aware project

skills.name: MCP: Extend Explorer For Tokens
skills.description: Surface APIToken management via Explorer

skills.name: MCP: MCP Admin Pages
skills.description: Use the `/smallstack/mcp/` Health / Tools / Activity admin pages from a debugging session

skills.name: MCP: Build MCP Solution
skills.description: "User wants Claude to do X" → decision tree for CRUDView vs `@tool` + copy-pasteable patterns. Start here when designing new MCP features.
skills.use_when: Before designing any MCP feature — CRUDView vs custom @tool, with copy-pasteable patterns.

skills.name: MCP: Verify MCP
skills.description: Consolidated verify checklist: doctor, --explain, make mcp-test, admin pages, dashboard widget, Claude Desktop — picks the right path per question

skills.name: MCP: Configure MCP
skills.description: Scenario → `MCP_*` setting map: turn off OAuth, custom theme, kamal-proxy, multi-tenant, verbose logging, autodiscover

skills.name: Database
skills.description: Database overview — SQLite default + tuning (WAL/IMMEDIATE), backups, when to switch, SQLite→Postgres data migration

skills.name: Postgres: Setup Local
skills.description: Switch a project to Postgres locally — Docker server, `psycopg` extra, `DATABASES` config, FTS auto-provision on migrate

skills.name: Postgres: Production
skills.description: Postgres in production — driver in the image, `DATABASE_URL`, `CONN_MAX_AGE`/PgBouncer, Kamal accessory, managed services, deploy-time search backfill, `pg_dump` backups (NOT `make backup`)

skills.name: Postgres: Testing
skills.description: Run the suite on Postgres — `TEST_DB=postgres` switch, the `--extra postgres` gotcha (`make test` can't), expected skip deltas, CI matrix

skills.name: Postgres: SQLite Vs Postgres
skills.description: **Read before search/migration/SQL work** — FTS self-provisioning, hyphen tokenization, `varchar` enforcement, query ordering, the "green on SQLite, red on Postgres" checklist
skills.use_when: Before search, data-migration, or raw-SQL work that must run on both engines.
